debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (RSI 9/14/21, Stochastic 84.89) combined with zero crossover confirmation, crisis-level VIX, unfavorable macro (flat yield curve, rising DXY), high earnings risk in 42 days, and weak fundamental/sentiment scores create pullback probability that outweighs technical strength.
